title: Pocket Money
text:
Tom gets pocket money every Saturday. He receives ten dollars from his parents. He saves most of the money in a small box. Sometimes he buys a comic book with the rest.

Anna's pocket money is five dollars a week. She likes to buy sweets and stickers. Last month she saved enough money to buy a new notebook. She was very happy with her choice.

questions.text: How often does Tom get pocket money?
What did Anna save money to buy?
Why does Tom keep most of his money in a box?
options: He wants to save it for something later
He gave it to his friend

questions.text: How does Anna probably feel about her new notebook?

paragraph_translations: Tomek dostaje kieszonkowe każdą sobotę. Otrzymuje dziesięć dolarów od rodziców. Większość pieniędzy oszczędza w małym pudełku. Czasami kupuje za resztę komiks.
Kieszonkowe Anny to pięć dolarów tygodniowo. Lubi kupować słodycze i naklejki. W zeszłym miesiącu uzbierała wystarczająco dużo pieniędzy na nowy zeszyt. Była bardzo zadowolona ze swojego wyboru.
